notes.title: What's Next
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's no secret that this game has no huge success and it's okay, I made and released this game as a learning experience for myself.

So, let's get right into what's coming in the future:



[h1]More Levels[/h1]
Before the support for this game ends, I want to add at least 2 more levels that are playable in survival & endless. Currently, there are 3 Levels but I want to make it 5 so it's a nice number.

[h1]More Items[/h1]
There are currently 2 Items: The Flashbang and The Syringe. This makes the gameplay repetitive quick, so I plan to add at least 2 more items ([i]cough decoy-grenade cough[/i]). I am also looking into a way to balance it so you can use more than 1 item per run and also implement them in endless mode.

[h1]Automated seasonal leaderboard[/h1]
To make this game playable for an infinite amount of time, I want to add seasonal leaderboards that reset every few months so players can compete with eachother. Of course old leaderboards would still be visible in game.

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
I think this one is quite clear, I want to adjust the strength of items, the behaviour of the monster and the amount of score you get for each "score event" (f.e. when you collect a cube)



And that's it! That's all that is currently planned to be added. I can't promise anything or give a time when this will be added and as always leave suggestions or bug reports in the discussions tab.

Have a great week!
